detail.description:
The Piney River is remote requiring commitment to attain.

Roads accessing the put-in and headwaters are usually closed until 1 June. (Gated/locked)

This river runs north toward State Bridge through remote and private terrain.

Wood is a solid part of the equation on this high elevation creek. There is significant deadfall in the region.

Alternate reference:  _The Floaters Guide to Colorado, D. Wheat_
